summary: Add pre-invoice meter health check step to month-end close checklist (usage-based billing controls)
description:
Request
- Add a mandatory pre-invoice “meter health check” step to the month-end close checklist to reduce invoice holds/credits caused by late-found meter issues.

Background
- January invoice cycle surfaced meter/aggregation variances late in the process, increasing risk of (a) invoice holds, (b) manual credits, and (c) audit questions about controls.
- Finance needs a lightweight, repeatable control that ties raw telemetry → billing-ready aggregates → invoice line items with documented sign-off.

Proposed checklist addition (to be executed prior to invoice generation)
1) Run daily reconciliation job (or ad-hoc run if daily job not yet available) for the invoice window and confirm deltas within tolerance.
2) Review anomaly dashboard for:
   - spend spikes (7d vs trailing baseline)
   - negative deltas / drops to zero for active accounts
   - missing dimensions (model/region/meter_version)
   - streaming outcome anomalies (disconnects, partial completions)
3) Confirm no active P0/P1 billing incidents affecting current invoice window.
4) Capture evidence (export summary + dashboard screenshot links) in the close folder / Confluence.
5) Obtain required sign-offs (Finance + Eng owner) before invoice run.

Acceptance criteria
- Close checklist updated with a clearly named step, owner, and links to the canonical runbook/dashboards.
- Defined tolerance and escalation path documented in the checklist step.
- Sign-off requirement explicitly stated (who, what evidence, where stored).
- Pilot executed for next invoice cycle with no material surprises discovered after invoice generation.

Approvers / required sign-off
- Finance (Billing Controls): Emily Stone
- Finance Exec Sponsor: Laura Bennett
- Engineering (Telemetry/Metering): Nadia Rahman (or delegate)
- Observability: Allison Grant (dashboard/alert owner)

Implementation notes
- This is primarily a process/control update; no billing system replatforming.
- If daily reconciliation automation is not ready, the control can be performed using the existing reconciliation queries + dashboards and recorded as evidence.

Risks / edge cases to call out in checklist text
- Backfills can temporarily trigger anomalies; include suppression/annotation guidance.
- Time zone alignment between console and invoice aggregation window.
- Streaming disconnect accounting and retry outcomes can create expected deltas depending on meter_version.

Requested completion date
- Before the next month-end invoice run (target: within 2 weeks).
comments:
2026-01-30 (Emily Stone): Creating internal task so this control is not "tribal knowledge". We need a single, auditable pre-invoice check and explicit sign-offs.

2026-01-31 (Talia Benson): Acknowledged. I’ll draft the checklist update + confirm where evidence should live. Tagging Nadia/Allison for links to the reconciliation output and anomaly dashboard.

2026-02-03 (Allison Grant): Dashboards are in progress; interim option is the existing Looker explore + Grafana panels. For checklist: link to the runbook and note how to handle backfill-related false positives (add annotation + temporary suppression).

2026-02-04 (Nadia Rahman): For reconciliation tolerance, we’ve been using <=0.5% token delta per account/day as "green" and 0.5–2% as "review" with known causes (retries/streaming). Anything >2% should block invoice for that account until triaged.

2026-02-06 (Emily Stone): Please make the checklist step explicit that we don’t hold the whole invoice run unless it’s systemic; we can isolate to impacted accounts and document the decision.

2026-02-10 (Talia Benson): Drafted checklist language and added sign-off section. Pending Laura approval on tolerance wording and "blocker" criteria.

2026-02-11 (Laura Bennett): Approved, with tweak: include a required note that any threshold change requires Finance+Eng approval and must be recorded with date/reason.

2026-02-12 (Talia Benson): Update merged into Confluence checklist page. Closing ticket; pilot will be executed next invoice cycle and any gaps will be logged as follow-ups.
resolution: Checklist updated in Confluence to include a mandatory pre-invoice meter health check step, including evidence capture requirements, tolerances, escalation path, and sign-offs (Finance + Eng). Links to reconciliation methodology/runbook and anomaly dashboard placeholders included. Approved by Finance sponsor and Telemetry/Metering owner.
